import re
flight_numbers = set()
for row in data:
  flight = re.sub(r'[^-a-zA-Z0-9]', '', row['flight'])
  if flight:
    flight_numbers.add(flight)

most_frequent = max(flight_numbers, key=flight_numbers.count)
return most_frequent
   This expression will remove any non-alphanumeric characters from the flight numbers and store them in a set for unique identification. Then it finds the most frequent flight number by counting each unique flight number using the `count()` method of the set object.
